reason: Unscaled residual additions may amplify activations across dilated blocks and destabilize optimization. Residual branch scaling directly addresses this model-level risk while preserving the frozen host.

plan.model_design: Apply fixed, depth-dependent residual branch scaling within NextItNetBlock. Set self.residual_scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(NUM_BLOCKS) in its existing constructor and multiply each completed residual branch output by this factor immediately before adding the unchanged skip connection. This controls accumulated residual updates while retaining causal dilated convolutions. Preserve existing variable names and the constructor, forward, encode_sequence, and score_candidates interfaces; add no imports, global constants, or host operations.
